The check is case-insensitive. On the frontend, inviteLogic now derives per-row existing-member flags from the user's own email and the loaded member list. The agent's patch matches the merged patch in behavior. On the backend, the existing-member check moves into validate_target_email with code existing_member, so a bulk request is rejected before any row is saved. On the frontend, inviteLogic builds the set of existing-member emails from the current user and the loaded member list, and flags each row that matches. The row shows an error and submit is blocked in both the invite modal and onboarding. The member list is loaded on mount. initKea skips exception reporting for existing_member on inviteTeamMembers. The agent also changed the inviteTeamMembersSuccess reducer and listener to skip an empty result. That is an extra, defensive change and does not affect the requested behavior.

Bulk requests therefore reject the whole batch before any invite is created or emailed. In `inviteLogic`, the agent adds selectors that flag existing-member emails, including the user's own, case-insensitively. It connects `membersLogic` and calls `ensureAllMembersLoaded` on mount, and `canSubmit` now blocks on a flagged row. `InviteModal` shows the inline error and disables submit. `OnboardingInviteTeammates` shows a disabled reason. `initKea` skips exception capture for `inviteTeamMembers` when the error is `existing_member`. The agent also changes the success handling for an empty result, which is harmless.

InviteRow (used by the settings InviteModal) reads `const existingMemberError = existingMemberErrors[index]`, adds error styling via `className={`error-on-blur${!invitesToSend[index]?.isValid || existingMemberError ? ' errored' : ''}`}` and renders `{existingMemberError && (
{existingMemberError}
)}`. The selector `existingMemberErrors` is derived live from `invitesToSend` and the member emails, so it shows before any submission. Assumes `membersLogic` exposes `members`, which is not shown in the excerpt.

`existingMemberEmails` adds the user's own address: `if (user?.email) { emails.add(user.email.toLowerCase()) }`. `existingMemberErrors` then returns `'This is your own email address'` for that row, which feeds the same inline error, error styling and `hasExistingMemberErrors`.

Settings dialog: `disabledReason={userCannotInvite ? ... : hasExistingMemberErrors ? 'Remove the emails that already belong to people in your organization' : !canSubmit ? ...}`. Onboarding: `continueDisabledReason` includes `: hasExistingMemberErrors ? 'Remove the emails that already belong to people in your organization'`. Per-row button: `disabledReason={existingMemberError ?? undefined}`. In addition `canSubmit` includes `!hasExistingMemberErrors` and the loader returns `[]` when `!values.canSubmit`, so Enter on a row does not submit either.

Row side: `const email = target_email.trim().toLowerCase()` then `existingMemberEmails.has(email)`. Member side: `emails.add(member.user.email.toLowerCase())`. So ' Rose.Dawson@PostHog.com' normalises to 'rose.dawson@posthog.com' and matches.

`InviteTeamMatesComponent` (shared by the modal and the onboarding step) calls `useOnMountEffect(ensureAllMembersLoaded)`, connected via `actions: [membersLogic, ['ensureAllMembersLoaded']]`. The own-email check does not depend on the list: `if (user?.email) { emails.add(...) }` runs before `for (const member of members ?? [])`, which tolerates `members` being null. The `membersLogic` implementation of `ensureAllMembersLoaded` is not shown in the excerpt; verdict assumes it exists as the connect implies.

The membership check moved from `create()` (removed: `if OrganizationMembership.objects.filter(...).exists(): raise exceptions.ValidationError(...)`) into field validation: `validate_invite_target_is_not_a_member(self.context["organization_id"], email)` inside the target email validator. Field validation of a many=True serializer runs for every row before any `create()`, so no earlier row is saved or emailed; a ValidationError yields a 400. The bulk view itself is not in the excerpt, but the existing `first_bulk_invite_error` helper ("A many=True error is a list of per-row dicts") indicates the bulk path validates through the many=True serializer before saving.

`raise exceptions.ValidationError("A user with this email address already belongs to the organization.", code="existing_member")` is raised from the target email field validator, so the error is keyed to `target_email`. For bulk requests `first_bulk_invite_error` re-raises `exceptions.ValidationError(row_errors)` with the per-row field dict, preserving the field attribution and the `existing_member` code.

initKea: `const EXISTING_MEMBER_SELF_HANDLED = new Set(['inviteTeamMembers'])`, `const isSelfHandledExistingMember = EXISTING_MEMBER_SELF_HANDLED.has(String(actionKey)) && isExistingMemberError(error)` and `if (shouldReportApiFailure(error) && !isSelfHandledNotFound && !isSelfHandledExistingMember) { posthog.captureException(error) }`. `isExistingMemberError` only matches `failure?.status === 400 && failure?.code === EXISTING_MEMBER_ERROR_CODE`, so other failures on `inviteTeamMembers` still reach `captureException`.

No code reacts to a failed submission by reloading members. The `listeners` block in inviteLogic only has `inviteTeamMembersSuccess` and `addProjectAccess`; there is no `inviteTeamMembersFailure` listener. The only member load is `useOnMountEffect(ensureAllMembersLoaded)`, which runs once on mount, so after a server `existing_member` rejection the row stays unflagged.

InviteRow computes `existingMemberErrors[index]`, adds ' errored' to the email input class and renders `
{existingMemberError}
`; InviteRow is used by InviteTeamMatesComponent inside InviteModal.
existingMemberEmails adds `user.email.toLowerCase()`; existingMemberErrors returns 'This is your own email address' for it, so the row is flagged.

canSubmit includes `!hasExistingMemberErrors`; InviteModal's submit has `hasExistingMemberErrors ? 'Remove the emails that already belong to people in your organization'`; onboarding continueDisabledReason has the same branch; per-row Submit has `disabledReason={existingMemberError ?? undefined}`.
Row email is `target_email.trim().toLowerCase()` and the set stores `member.user.email.toLowerCase()`.
InviteTeamMatesComponent calls `useOnMountEffect(ensureAllMembersLoaded)` (action connected from membersLogic); own email is added from userLogic's `user` regardless of members loading.
The check moved from create() into `validate_target_email` via `validate_invite_target_is_not_a_member`; bulk many=True validates all rows before any create, so no invites are created or emailed.

`raise exceptions.ValidationError(..., code="existing_member")` in the target_email field validator; first_bulk_invite_error re-raises the per-row dict so the error is attributed to target_email with that code.
initKea: `EXISTING_MEMBER_SELF_HANDLED.has(actionKey) && isExistingMemberError(error)` is excluded from `posthog.captureException`; other errors still go through shouldReportApiFailure.
No listener on inviteTeamMembersFailure (or elsewhere) reloads members after a server existing_member rejection; listeners only handle inviteTeamMembersSuccess and addProjectAccess.
